test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The experiment is being completed by the whole class.

options.text: The whole class is completing the experiment.
The whole class has been completing experiment.
The whole class completes the experiment.
The whole class has completed the experiment.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The whole class is completing the experiment."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the experiment" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is completing" to "is being completed" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the whole class."
 
• Ensure the sentence structure remains clear and maintains the same meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The whole class is completing the experiment."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The whole class has been completing the experiment." – Incorrect tense (present perfect continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"The whole class completes the experiment." – Incorrect tense (simple present).
 
• **Option 4: **"The whole class has completed the experiment." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
